# ============================================================================
# PROVENANCE (Amethyst Task211 vendor)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# This tree is the CLASSIC gl4es -- the "gl4es" used by ZalithLauncher 2 as
# its legacy renderer (ZL2's library table: gl4es_extra_extra, prebuilt as
# libgl4es_114.so, ZL2 caps it at MC 1.21.4):
#   upstream : https://github.com/PojavLauncherTeam/gl4es_extra_extra
#              (fork chain of ptitSeb/gl4es + PojavLauncherTeam/gl4es-114;
#              MIT, (c) 2016-2018 Sebastien Chevalier, (c) 2013-2016 Ryan
#              Hileman)
#   snapshot : codeload tarball refs/heads/master, fetched 2026-10-02
#   pruning  : traces/ (46MB apitrace dumps), spec/, refs/, media/, tests/,
#              external/ (MetalANGLE .tbd stub), .github/, agl/ (Amiga),
#              Android*.mk, bc_cat.h, gl4es.png, test.cmake, _config.yml.
#   kept     : src/ (gl/ + glx/, unmodified except the two adaptations
#              below), include/, version.h, LICENSE, README/COMPILE/CHANGELOG/
#              USAGE/MEDIA docs.
#
# Amethyst adaptations vs the upstream build (4):
#  1. Own CMakeLists (this file) replacing the upstream root+src pair:
#     upstream's non-Linux path builds GL_SRC + glx/hardext.c ONLY (the
#     Linux-only glx.c/gbm.c/lookup.c/streaming.c/utils.c/rpi.c and the
#     Amiga agl/ are never compiled on Darwin -- verified against
#     src/CMakeLists.txt's `if(Linux AND NOT NO_LOADER)` split), so most of
#     the NG-port's glx battle scars (xrefresh system(), GLVND tail) do not
#     exist here. project() is C-only: the classic converter is the pure-C
#     string-rewriting shaderconv.c -- NO glslang, NO SPIRV-Cross, no C++
#     TU anywhere (unlike NG's glsl_for_es.cpp trio); dep_gl4eszl2 therefore
#     has NO dep_mg dependency and cannot race the glslang statics.
#  2. NOX11 + NOEGL + NO_GBM + DEFAULT_ES=2 + NO_INIT_CONSTRUCTOR always
#     defined. DEFAULT_ES=2 = the upstream Android semantics (the classic
#     wrapper targets ES2 on the ES3-capable context; upstream's CMake only
#     knows 1/2 and defaults to 2 off-Pandora). NOEGL = the Task179 lesson:
#     hardware probing runs on the CURRENT host context, backend resolution
#     goes through proc_address (host pins it via set_getprocaddress, the
#     Task204 resolver pattern). NO_INIT_CONSTRUCTOR = the Task208 lesson:
#     the renderer dylib is dlopened by the unified preload BEFORE any EGL
#     context exists, so the constructor-time hardware probe would
#     SIGSEGV (the NG crash); initialize_gl4es stays a plain export and the
#     host (egl_bridge.m ame211_gl4eszl2_boot) calls it after MakeCurrent.
#  3. -fvisibility=hidden (house pattern; upstream uses =default): EXPORT /
#     asm .global is the only exported surface. This requires one source
#     adaptation -- init.c's set_getprocaddress gains EXPORT (upstream relies
#     on default visibility; NG's tree already had EXPORT there).
#  4. src/glx/hardext.c: NULL guard on the GL_EXTENSIONS string before the
#     strstr family (`if (!Exts) Exts = "";` + one-time log) -- the Task208
#     defense in depth (a context-less probe degrades to "no extensions"
#     instead of SIGSEGV in _platform_strstr).
#  5. src/gl/wrap/gl4eszl2_darwin_aliases.c (GENERATED by
#     scripts/task211_gen_gl4eszl2_aliases.py) is added to the source list:
#     upstream's attributes.h retires AliasExport(name) to nothing on
#     __APPLE__, so the ~1200 `RET NAME(ARGS) AliasExport("gl4es_NAME");`
#     declarations (plus the STUB / THUNK / GL_GET_MAP macro families that
#     expand to the same shape) export nothing and LWJGL/MC resolution of
#     plain gl* names would fall through to the raw ANGLE frameworks (the
#     Task204 two-GL-namespaces disease).
#
# Driven by the Makefile dep_gl4eszl2 target (standalone -- no deps). Output
# libgl4eszl2.dylib is copied to $(WORKINGDIR) and rides the payload
# "cp $(WORKINGDIR)/*.dylib" into the app Frameworks, like vgpu/ltw/nggl4es.
# ============================================================================
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.10)
project(gl4eszl2 LANGUAGES C)

set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 11)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

# --- cache input filled in by the Makefile dep_gl4eszl2 target -------------
set(GL4ESZL2_FRAMEWORK_DIR "" CACHE PATH "Amethyst resources/Frameworks (bundled ANGLE libEGL + libGLESv2)")
# NOTE: quoted STREQUAL form (Task206i CI lesson: unquoted if(NOT VAR) on a
# list expands into multiple arguments and misfires; and CMake has NO
# backslash line continuation -- if() spans lines naturally).
if("${GL4ESZL2_FRAMEWORK_DIR}" STREQUAL "")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "dep_gl4eszl2 must pass GL4ESZL2_FRAMEWORK_DIR (see Makefile); got FRAMEWORKS='${GL4ESZL2_FRAMEWORK_DIR}'")
endif()

# Upstream flags kept (-std=gnu11 -funwind-tables); visibility flipped to
# hidden (adaptation 3) so EXPORT / asm .global is the only exported surface.
set(CMAKE_C_FLAGS "${CMAKE_C_FLAGS} -fPIC -funwind-tables -fvisibility=hidden -DNO_GBM -DDEFAULT_ES=2 -DNOX11 -DNOEGL -DNO_INIT_CONSTRUCTOR")

include_directories(
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src
)

# Source list = upstream src/CMakeLists.txt GL_SRC verbatim (the ~70 gl/
# files + wrap trio + math + vgpu/shaderconv) + the non-Linux hardext.c
# entry + the Task211 generated darwin aliases.
set(GL4ESZL2_SRC
    src/gl/arbconverter.c
    src/gl/arbgenerator.c
    src/gl/arbhelper.c
    src/gl/arbparser.c
    src/gl/array.c
    src/gl/blit.c
    src/gl/blend.c
    src/gl/buffers.c
    src/gl/build_info.c
    src/gl/debug.c
    src/gl/decompress.c
    src/gl/depth.c
    src/gl/directstate.c
    src/gl/drawing.c
    src/gl/enable.c
    src/gl/envvars.c
    src/gl/eval.c
    src/gl/face.c
    src/gl/fog.c
    src/gl/fpe.c
    src/gl/fpe_cache.c
    src/gl/fpe_shader.c
    src/gl/framebuffers.c
    src/gl/gl_lookup.c
    src/gl/getter.c
    src/gl/gl4es.c
    src/gl/glstate.c
    src/gl/hint.c
    src/gl/init.c
    src/gl/light.c
    src/gl/line.c
    src/gl/list.c
    src/gl/listdraw.c
    src/gl/listrl.c
    src/gl/loader.c
    src/gl/logs.c
    src/gl/matrix.c
    src/gl/matvec.c
    src/gl/oldprogram.c
    src/gl/pixel.c
    src/gl/planes.c
    src/gl/pointsprite.c
    src/gl/preproc.c
    src/gl/program.c
    src/gl/queries.c
    src/gl/raster.c
    src/gl/render.c
    src/gl/shader.c
    src/gl/shaderconv.c
    src/gl/shader_hacks.c
    src/gl/stack.c
    src/gl/stencil.c
    src/gl/string_utils.c
    src/gl/stubs.c
    src/gl/texenv.c
    src/gl/texgen.c
    src/gl/texture.c
    src/gl/texture_compressed.c
    src/gl/texture_params.c
    src/gl/texture_read.c
    src/gl/texture_3d.c
    src/gl/uniform.c
    src/gl/vertexattrib.c
    src/gl/vgpu/shaderconv.c
    src/gl/wrap/gl4eswraps.c
    src/gl/wrap/gles.c
    src/gl/wrap/glstub.c
    src/gl/math/matheval.c
    # non-Linux branch of upstream src/CMakeLists.txt
    src/glx/hardext.c
    # Task211: generated darwin aliases (bare gl* -> gl4es_gl*)
    src/gl/wrap/gl4eszl2_darwin_aliases.c
)

add_library(gl4eszl2 SHARED ${GL4ESZL2_SRC})

target_include_directories(gl4eszl2 PRIVATE
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src
)

# Bundled ANGLE frameworks (same line as the nggl4es/vgpu targets): linking
# them makes them LC_LOAD_DYLIB dependencies, so dlsym(renderer_handle,
# name) dependency-closure fallback for pure-ES names the wrapper does NOT
# export resolves on the bundled ANGLE instead of some random image.
target_link_libraries(gl4eszl2 PRIVATE
    "-F${GL4ESZL2_FRAMEWORK_DIR}"
    "-framework libEGL"
    "-framework libGLESv2"
)

set_target_properties(gl4eszl2 PROPERTIES
    OUTPUT_NAME "gl4eszl2"
    MACOSX_RPATH ON
)
